title: Customer Follow-up Email
description: Reconnect after a conversation and agree on next steps.
content:
Subject: Next steps after [Meeting or conversation]

Hi [Customer name],

Thank you for discussing [Topic] with us. It was helpful to learn about [Customer priority].

## What we discussed
- [Key point one]
- [Key point two]

## Next steps
1. [Action and owner]
2. [Action and deadline]

Would [Proposed date] work for our next conversation?

Best,
[Your name]
use_cases: 客户跟进邮件 售后回访 跟进沟通
